title: Sources: data center operator Switch has hired investment banks for a US IPO that could raise up to $10B and value it at $80B, set for as soon as Q4 (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources: data center operator Switch has hired investment banks for a US IPO that could raise up to $10B and value it at $80B, set for as soon as Q4 — Data center operator Switch is preparing for a significant initial public offering. This offering could potentially raise up to ten billion dollars soon.
